verdict.rationale: Plausible documents a Stats API (/api/v2/query) for programmatic aggregated stats queries, scoped by API key, plus a CSV 'Export stats' feature — but there is no evidence of a raw event-level query API or SQL/warehouse-style access to underlying event data; the Events API is only for ingesting events, not querying them. missing for 10: documented raw event-level export/query endpoint, SQL or warehouse-style querying, OpenAPI spec (probes show 404s for openapi/docs.md).
